title: ADBC driver for Power BI is now generally available
body: The Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC) driver for the Databricks connector for Power BI is now generally available. ADBC is the default driver for new connections in Power BI Desktop and the Power BI service. See [Configure ADBC or ODBC driver for Power BI](/aws/en/partners/bi/power-bi/adbc).

ref_links.text: Configure ADBC or ODBC driver for Power BI
